predictions.rationale: Core domain entity that defines the Order aggregate, its lifecycle, status transitions, and business rules for creation, cancellation, payment, shipping.
Primary API surface for creating, retrieving, cancelling, and tracking orders; orchestrates command/query dispatch tied to the ordering workflow.
Repository implementation that persists and retrieves Order aggregates, directly supporting all ordering operations.
Handles CreateOrderCommand to build and save a new Order at checkout, initiating the ordering process.
Updates an Order’s status to Paid after successful payment, a key step in order tracking.
Transitions an Order to Stock-Confirmed once inventory is validated, part of order status workflow.
Implements business logic to cancel existing orders and update their status accordingly.
Handles shipping command, marking orders as shipped and finalising the ordering lifecycle.
Enumeration/value object that defines all possible order statuses (Created, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled, etc.) used throughout ordering logic.
Provides read-model queries to fetch order details and status, supporting tracking and management of orders.
